content:
Before he was known as the Half-Mortal, the Black Devil, and before the events that would dub him as the Suneater, the man behind the legend was simply Hadrian Marlowe. Christopher Ruocchio’s science-fiction epic, The Sun Eater, tells the harrowing tale of how the son of duke who dreamed of being an explorer and scholar would go on to destroy a star and an entire civilization. And with Amazon's Black Friday sale, the first book that started it all, Empire of Silence, is currently on sale for only $12.26.

For fans of science fiction, flawed heroes, and books that will make you ball your eyes out (at least it did for me) The Sun Eater is one of the best modern science fiction series that I’ve read in quite some time. After having devoured the books earlier this year, the tale of Hadrian (who I lovingly explain to my friends is “what if Jesus was a Jedi”) and his Red Company quickly has become one of my favorite reads in a long time, putting it right up there with Pierce Brown’s Red Rising series.

With the nights getting dark earlier, and as you find yourself spending more time inside, there’s no better time to hunker down with a good book, and with this sale, there’s no better time to pick up Empire of Silence and begin to hear Hadrian’s story. Earlier this year, we published a full breakdown of Ruocchio’s series, highlighting book order along with where the various novellas slot into the timeline, so you will know what comes next, too!

The Sun Eater Reading Order

For those just getting into the series, it's worth noting that there are seven full-length novels and seven novellas.

The Lesser Devil (Novella)
